name: @tomgrv/vps-coder
description: Coder (remote development environments) with in-cluster PostgreSQL

CODER_ACCESS_URL.description: Externally reachable URL of Coder (default: http://coder.<wildcard domain>)

CODER_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Email of the first Coder admin (default: admin@<wildcard domain>)

CODER_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password of the first Coder admin (default: generated and saved)

CODER_ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Username of the first Coder admin

CODER_CHART_VERSION.description: Pin the Coder chart version (e.g. 2.37.4 stable); empty = latest

CODER_DB_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password for Coder (default: generated and saved)

DEVCONTAINER_BUILDER_REF.description: Pinned tag/commit of github.com/DeepSpaceCartel/devcontainer-builder whose Coder template is pushed (required with the registry credentials)

DEVCONTAINER_BUILDER_VERSION.description: Pinned devcontainer-builder Helm chart version (required with the registry credentials)

DEVCONTAINER_REGISTRY.description: Container registry devcontainer-builder pushes images to

DEVCONTAINER_REGISTRY_ORG.description: Registry org/user images are pushed under

DEVCONTAINER_REGISTRY_TOKEN.description: Registry token able to push and pull (GHCR: write:packages); with user, org and the two pins it enables devcontainer-builder, else the Envbuilder starter is used
